'''Pangalactus''' was a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] whose air was rich with exotic spices. Every dining room within was equipped with floor-to-ceiling monitors that could display total-immersion visuals from a vast library of images, including vistas of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and recreations of famous moments in the history of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The restaurant served a wide variety of meals, including [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]], [[Hapan]], and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]-style cuisine.

[[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Jagged Fel]] dined with his fiancée [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Solo family/Legends|Solo's family]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] and [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]] [[Solo family/Legends|Solo]] in [[43 ABY]] at a dinner that was overseen by several members of Fel's security detail and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. The dinner was quickly interrupted by an [[Operation Duusha|assassination attempt]] on Fel by [[Kester Tolann]], and one on the Solos by two [[YVH-Series battle droid]]s. The occupants of the private room quickly halted the [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], who were, unbeknownst to their targets, working for the Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] and the [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen]].
